Root cause: searchInDirectory's hand-rolled 'while (regex.exec(line))' loop in electron.js never advanced lastIndex past a zero-width match (e.g. bare '$' -- end-of-line anchor, which users naturally search for since Ren'Py statement lines start with $). Fixed by extracting match collection into src/lib/regexLineSearch.js's findRegexMatchesInLine, which manually bumps lastIndex on zero-width matches. Root cause: off-by-one line indexing in StatsView.tsx's character word-count computation. useRenpyAnalysis.ts stores dialogueLines with 1-based line numbers (index + 1, matching Monaco's convention), but StatsView.tsx indexed the 0-based scriptLines array directly with dl.line instead of dl.line - 1, so it read the line AFTER each actual dialogue line. That line usually isn't a quoted dialogue line, so the DIALOGUE_RE match failed and word counts stayed at 0 for every character, which also zeroed the Word Count By Character graph. Fixed by indexing scriptLines[dl.line - 1]. Added a regression test in StatsView.test.tsx. Full suite (2114 tests), tsc, lint, build all green.

Root cause: searchInDirectory's hand-rolled 'while (regex.exec(line))' loop in electron.js never advanced lastIndex past a zero-width match (e.g. bare '$' -- end-of-line anchor, which users naturally search for since Ren'Py statement lines start with $). This froze the synchronous ipcMain.handle call, hanging the whole main process. Fixed by extracting match collection into src/lib/regexLineSearch.js's findRegexMatchesInLine, which manually bumps lastIndex on zero-width matches. Added regexLineSearch.test.ts proving termination within 100ms for '/$/g' and '/^/g'. Full suite (2113 tests), tsc, lint, build all green.

Root cause: off-by-one line indexing in StatsView.tsx's character word-count computation. useRenpyAnalysis.ts stores dialogueLines with 1-based line numbers (index + 1, matching Monaco's convention), but StatsView.tsx indexed the 0-based scriptLines array directly with dl.line instead of dl.line - 1, so it read the line AFTER each actual dialogue line. That line usually isn't a quoted dialogue line, so the DIALOGUE_RE match failed and word counts stayed at 0 for every character, which also zeroed the Word Count By Character graph. Fixed by indexing scriptLines[dl.line - 1]. Added a regression test in StatsView.test.tsx. Full suite (2114 tests), tsc, lint, build all green.
